facts.fact: StackAdapt was awarded the Platinum Hermes Creative Award in the Interactive Media & Digital Advertising category for a video ad in the 2024 Hermes Creative Awards.
facts.quote: has been awarded the prestigious Platinum Hermes Creative Award in the Interactive Media & Digital Advertising category for the company’s recent video ad.

facts.fact: The Hermes Creative Awards 2024 competition received over 6,500 entries from the United States, Canada, and 36 other countries.
facts.quote: There were over 6,500 entries from throughout the United States, Canada, and 36 other countries in the Hermes Creative Awards 2024 competition.

facts.fact: Winners in the Hermes Creative Awards were selected from over 200 categories.
facts.quote: Winners were selected from over 200 categories grouped under advertising, publications, marketing/branding, integrated marketing, public relations/communications, electronic media, and pro bono.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes itself as used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a multi-channel programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
